*Updated 2026-09-28 · 106 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and six works. The September 28 courgette piece scores 2, closing the last twelve at 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2 — median holds at 2, the hurricane barometer's 3 still the only outlier in the window, and nothing has moved the ceiling since the Hiroshima dress scored 3 in late July and the rebar piece hit 4 at the end of that same month.

Camera position remains the most measurable problem. Straight-on accounts for 27 of 106 all-time, overhead 10, from-behind 10, low-angle 4. The last twelve show one overhead — the rubble piece — and eleven that are frontal or unspecified. Every score of 4 in the archive came from a displaced geometric axis: overhead flatness, through-frame compression, or a low angle that restructured the subject's weight entirely. The barometer's 3 arrived through perceptual estrangement inside a conventional frame, and that is the closest frontal work has come to the ceiling. It is not a reliable substitute. The camera has not moved in any systematic way for two months, and without that move the scores will not lift.

Scale violation sits at 30 of 106 all-time but only 5 of the last 12, which looks like a slight recovery but includes the aubergine seedling and water jug, both of which built scale violation into the conceit rather than discovering it through the anchor. Genuine discovery — scale violated because no other answer fit — has been rarer. Figures continue their retreat: the last twelve show none or one per frame consistently, and the focal-object discipline holds — courgette, stump, tin can, fallen cylinder, closed eye, barometer needle — no repetition inside that window.

Register compression is unchanged: aftermath and menace together account for 42 of 106. Foreboding appeared twice in the last twelve, encroachment once, exhaustion dormant since Bangladesh. Betrayed defiance, reprieve, and reckoning each appeared once across the full archive and have not returned. Title grammar continues to drift: six of the last twelve are miscellaneous constructions with no consolidating shape.

The work is sustained and disciplined at its floor. Discipline is not producing a ceiling. The camera moves first; everything else follows from that.
